newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end quiet session slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end quiet session slightly higher.

text.p: VIENNA, July 29 (Reuter) Austrian bonds ended moderately higher on Tuesday after a quiet session. Traders said limited demand centred on the five-year period.
They saw little impact from U.S. data. The July consumer confidence index came in at 126.5, slightly below expectations. The second quarter employment cost index rose 0.8 percent, as forecast.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 up 15 bps at 100.15 to yield 5.60 (5.62) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.13/23 to yield 5.61/59 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 steady at 99.60 to yield 4.72 (4.72) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.63/71 to yield 4.71/69 percent.
* Austrian bond future up 14 bps at 110.09.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at six bps, five-year spread down one at 21 bps.
* Money market rates mixed with three-month VIBOR steady at 3.400 and overnight money alsightly firmer at 3.13/3.38.
